title: Choice of Fate
next_chapter_hook: When the rules of fate's chess game begin to crumble, those sleeping pieces awaken one after another—everything Chen Ji has woven shall finally bloom in its most dazzling radiance at this moment.

text.content: In the endless Void, Chen Ji's divine consciousness floats like a lone boat. The voice of the Heavenly Eye still echoes, that existence beyond cause and effect, transcending reincarnation, awaits his answer with unprecedented patience. 'Accept the manipulation of fate, or tear open the black curtain shrouding all lives' destinies at the cost of losing everything?' These words sear into the depths of his Mental Sea, each echo burning his fragile spirit.

Chen Ji surveys his surroundings—in this void, countless light specks glimmer faintly in the distance. Those are the threads of fate belonging to countless mortals, woven by the Heavenly Eye into a sky-covering net. And he, Chen Ji, is merely an ant attempting to struggle free. The Heavenly Eye's voice resurfaces, tinged with enticement: 'For millennia, countless seers have chosen submission before you. You are the first to reach this point—accept my proposal, and you shall become the new Chess Player.'

dialogue.content: 'Why do you think Chen Xuan failed? Simply because he didn't understand following the current.' The Heavenly Eye's voice carries a hint of mockery. 'He sought to defy heaven with a mortal body, only to be reduced to ashes by heavenly tribulation. You are different—you possess the Tianji Record Fragment, you've proven your worth. Accept my power, become the new heaven, and you can rewrite everyone's destiny, including your sister taken away by the Holy Sect.'

text.content: Chen Nian! This name explodes in Chen Ji's heart like thunder. His sister—the true origin of his grand schemes across the world these years, his flawless calculations. The Heavenly Eye indeed knows everything, using Chen Nian's existence to shake his resolve. Chen Ji takes a deep breath; beneath that seemingly timid face, his eyes are cold as ten-thousand-year-old ice. He coldly thinks within: 'I've noted this.' This is his consistent style—bearing grudges without acting rashly.

Just then, a gentle yet resolute voice speaks within his Mental Sea: 'Ji'er, don't be deceived by it.' It's Mo Xiansheng! That mysterious existence guarding the Tianji Record in spirit remnant form, now actually initiating communication with him. Mo Xiansheng's voice carries a hint of approval: 'You've finally reached this step. Back then, Chen Xuan faced the same choice—he chose refusal, but he couldn't find the third path. And you—you hold in your hands the method he left behind to break the game.'

The complete version of the Tianji Record unfolds slowly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. This prophetic divine book is not the exclusive product of the Heavenly Eye, but a spark left behind by some transcendent being of ancient times. Its true purpose was never to make seers become new Chess Players, but—to awaken all beings bound by fate. Chen Ji finally understands Chen Xuan's true intention—he wasn't seeking to replace heaven, but to shatter this damn chessboard!

dialogue.content: 'Are you hesitating?' The Heavenly Eye's voice suddenly turns cold, its supreme pressure bearing down like a mountain. 'I'll give you the time of burning one incense stick to consider. If you refuse, your sister shall be reduced to nothingness in the Heavenly Fate Furnace. The Tianqing Sect, Xuanwu Sect, Holy Sect—everyone connected to you shall turn to ash beneath heavenly punishment. This is the final ultimatum.'

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughs—that smile carries traces of madness, of release. He thinks of his arrangements over the years—Su Qingyao's protection, Ye Qing's Demonic Path fog, Han Lie's repeated defeats, Ling Yuan's步步紧逼. Everything, all of it, are pieces on his chessboard. And now, he will awaken all these pieces, transforming this sky-covering net into countless blades piercing through the heavens!

Just then, a blurry figure appears beside Chen Ji, flickering in and out of visibility. It's a girl's silhouette, gentle eyes carrying anxiety and hope. Chen Nian—his sister, that existence taken by the Holy Sect as the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.' Her appearance makes Chen Ji's heart tremble violently, yet it also solidifies his resolve. He murmurs softly: 'Niannian, big brother has come to save you.'

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji, are you certain?' Mo Xiansheng's voice carries a hint of gravity. 'Once the awakening method initiates, you will lose all protection from your Heavenly Fate Value and directly endure heaven's backlash. This isn't sacrifice, this is—' Chen Ji interrupts him, a familiar cold smile curling at his lips: 'Playing the pig to eat the tiger for so many years, it's time to show this heaven what a true chess master looks like.'

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closes his eyes. The complete Tianji Record blazes with dazzling light within his Mental Sea. He can feel his Heavenly Fate Value rapidly draining away—that's his life foundation, the trump card he carefully accumulated over so many years. But he shows not the slightest hesitation—he wants not to replace heaven, but to give everyone the right to rewrite their own destiny! This is Chen Xuan's true legacy to him!

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's pressure grows increasingly overwhelming. Chen Ji must make his choice within the time limit. At this moment, he will choose his own path—

choices.text: Accept Proposal · Become the New Heaven
choices.description: Using Chen Nian and all living beings as stakes, accept the Heavenly Eye's legacy and become the new Chess Player. This is the safest choice, but Chen Ji will be bound by fate forever.
choices.visible_cost: Lose hope of freedom for all you care about
choices.visible_reward: Gain the power to command heaven, able to rewrite anyone's destiny
choices.risk_hint: Appearing to gain everything, actually becoming the Heavenly Eye's puppet

text.content: Just as Chen Ji is about to speak, the Tianji Record within his Mental Sea suddenly vibrates violently. A gentle yet resolute force surges from within the pages—that is Chen Xuan's residual will. He used his final obsession to illuminate the third path for Chen Ji.

choices.description: Using Heavenly Fate Value as the price, forcibly drive the complete Tianji Record's power, perishing together with the Heavenly Eye. This is the path Chen Xuan failed to complete.
choices.visible_reward: Perish together with the Heavenly Eye, yet all beings remain trapped within fate
choices.risk_hint: Appearing heroic, actually meaningless—heaven will be reborn, and all will continue to be manipulated
choices.process_label: chen xuan's shadow appears in light...

text.content: Chen Ji's hand trembles slightly as the Tianji Record's power churns within him. However, at this moment, a familiar voice resounds in his heart—Chen Xuan's final remnant thought: 'Child, do not repeat my mistakes. Destruction is not an ending, but a new cycle.'

choices.text: Path of Awakening · Using Shackles as Keys
choices.description: Not the path of replacement, but using shackles as keys to unlock the awakening switch for all pieces. Let every existence bound by fate possess the power to break their own destiny.
choices.visible_cost: Consume all Heavenly Fate Value, endure heaven's backlash
choices.visible_reward: Awaken all sleeping pieces, rewrite the rules of fate's chess game
choices.risk_hint: An unprecedented path with unknown costs, but if successful, will fundamentally change everything
choices.process_label: heavenly record resonates, fate's gears turn...

dialogue.content: 'Brother...' Chen Nian's figure suddenly becomes clear. Those eyes, imprisoned by the Holy Sect for years, finally reflect rays of hope. She can feel—an unprecedented power is awakening the sleeping Heavenly Fate Lock Key within her. 'I see... everyone can now see their own destiny!'

choices.memory_label: 陈机选择了最不可能的道路——觉醒众生，改写规则

text.content: The Heavenly Eye seems to sense something. That ancient consciousness stream first shows an emotion of surprise. It cannot comprehend—this mere mortal dares to toy with the fate's shackles it personally established before it. 'You—what are you doing!' In the Heavenly Eye's voice, an emotion called fear appears for the first time.

Chen Ji slowly opens his eyes. Those pupils reflect the entire chessboard of fate. He sees Su Qingyao raising her head in the Tianqing Sect Inner Sect, understanding flickering in her eyes; sees Ye Qing suddenly rising in the Demonic Path Holy Sect, the surrounding demonic fog beginning to churn; sees Han Lie howling at the sky in the Xuanwu Sect, battle intent erupting like a volcano; even sees Ling Yuan's cunning face, for the first time showing an expression called panic.

dialogue.content: 'Stop!' The Heavenly Eye's voice carries unprecedented urgency. 'You madman! Once the Path of Awakening initiates, fate's rules will completely collapse! All order, cause and effect, reincarnation shall be destroyed! You think you're saving them? No—you are destroying the entire cultivation world!'

text.content: Chen Ji sneers, that smile carrying traces of pride overlooking the world. He thinks of his years of endurance—from thetrash (useless) servant in the Tianqing Sect, to the ridiculed talentless disciple, to today's chess master using shackles as keys to awaken all beings. He slowly speaks, voice not loud yet thundering through the entire Void: 'Destruction? I think rather—it is remolding.'

choice.prompt: The process of awakening has initiated, yet the Heavenly Eye's counterattack follows immediately. Chen Ji must make his final choice—

choices.description: Driving the Tianji Record with disregard for everything, letting the power of awakening explode completely. This is the unfinished cause Chen Xuan left behind; Chen Ji will complete it for him.
choices.visible_cost: Endure all of heaven's backlash, possibly body and spirit destroyed
choices.visible_reward: All pieces awaken simultaneously, fate's chess game completely disintegrates
choices.risk_hint: Death leads to rebirth—if successful, shall write a new legend

text.content: The seal on the Tianji Record shatters completely at this moment. Countless golden characters scatter like fireflies, drifting toward every corner of the Three Thousand Worlds. And Chen Ji himself endures the excruciating pain of heaven's backlash—his body begins to crack, as if about to shatter into dust at any moment.

choices.description: Using the game-breaking method Chen Xuan left behind, using shackles as keys, awaken each piece gradually, reducing the damage from backlash.
choices.visible_cost: Awakening time extended, giving the Heavenly Eye opportunity to counterattack
choices.visible_reward: Maintain own mental clarity, ensuring the ability to continue planning
choices.risk_hint: Appearing safe, actually possibly allowing the Heavenly Eye to find counterattack opportunities

dialogue.content: 'Well done.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carries a hint of praise. 'Chen Xuan failed back then precisely because he was too radical, leading to his body's destruction. You understand following the current better than him—that is your advantage.' Chen Ji's lips curve slightly—he was never a hero, only a chess master with flawless calculations.

text.content: No matter what choice Chen Ji makes, the process of awakening has irreversibly begun. The Heavenly Eye's roar echoes through the Void, yet can no longer stop those rays of golden light breaking through fate's cage. And in every corner of the Three Thousand Worlds, those pieces bound by fate are awakening one after another—their eyes all reflect a blurry figure, a man who posed as trash for years yet had flawless calculations.

In the Tianqing Sect Inner Sect, Su Qingyao suddenly stands up. She can feel her thread of fate vibrating violently. Thattrash servant she investigated for years, that man who thrice brought her infinitely close to the truth yet thrice resolved it—now appears in her destiny in a posture she never imagined. She murmurs softly: 'Chen Ji... so from the very beginning, you never intended to be anytrash.'

Deep within the Demonic Path Holy Sect, the demonic fog around Ye Qing suddenly churns. She sees the prophecy Chen Ji left for her—that prophecy only she could understand, that prompted her to choose cooperation. Now she finally understands—that seemingly timid man was from the beginning playing a game of chess she couldn't imagine. A complex smile curves her lips: 'Chen Ji... you truly didn't disappoint me.'

dialogue.content: 'No... impossible!' The Heavenly Eye's voice carries desperate trembling. 'I am heaven, the master of fate, the existence above all! How can a mere mortal break the shackles I established!' Yet no matter how it rages, those rays of golden light have already penetrated the web of fate it wove for tens of millions of years, extending toward countless imprisoned souls.

text.content: Chen Ji quietly observes all this. His body is already deeply cracked, Heavenly Fate Value almost exhausted, yet his smile grows increasingly brilliant. He thinks of his sister—that girl taken by the Holy Sect as the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.' At this moment, Chen Nian's figure gradually solidifies beside him. Those gentle eyes finally reflect the light of freedom. Chen Ji murmurs softly: 'Niannian, from now on, no one can control your destiny anymore.'
